title: A Letter About a Job
text:
I am writing to ask about the office assistant job at your company. I saw the advertisement in the newspaper last week. I have three years of experience, and I speak English and French.

Please find my CV attached to this letter. I would be happy to come to an interview at any time that suits you. Thank you for your time and consideration.

questions.text: Where did the writer see the advertisement?
What is attached to the letter?
What can we infer about the writer?
options: They want to get a job
They are the manager of the company

questions.text: What does the writer probably expect next?

vocabulary.definition: a notice that offers something, such as a job
knowledge or skill gained by doing a job or activity
a formal meeting where someone asks questions about a job
sent together with something else, such as with a letter or email

paragraph_translations: Я пишу, щоб запитати про посаду офісного асистента у вашій компанії. Я побачив оголошення в газеті минулого тижня. У мене три роки досвіду, і я володію англійською та французькою мовами.
Будь ласка, знайдіть моє резюме, прикріплене до цього листа. Я б із радістю прийшов на співбесіду в будь-який зручний для вас час. Дякую за ваш час і розгляд моєї кандидатури.
